weights_source.reference: ADR-005 (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) + ADR-012 (dimensional fit): style and color dominate interior-design preference, budget is a strong practical filter, material is a secondary preference, pattern is a tiebreaker; fit penalises furniture that physically does not belong in the room the quiz described.
weights_source.tuning_plan: Not tuned on interaction data. Revisit only with an offline evaluation set and a logged experiment; any change bumps config_version and requires re-running the acceptance scenarios (tests/test_recommender.py) and the scenario harness (scripts/evaluate_recommender.py), including under every profile (see profiles below and docs/reports/weights_profiles.md).

current.source: ADR-005 baseline + ADR-012 fit component: style/color .25/.25 (each gave up .05 to fund fit), budget .20, material .15, pattern .05, fit .10. Fit is a physical constraint, not a taste signal, so it is funded from the two taste weights rather than from budget.

client-ad.source: Client advertisement weights normalised to sum to 1 (material .15 -> .10 absorbs the ad's extra pattern .05, open client decision C-6), plus the ADR-012 fit component funded from style/color exactly as in `current`.

current-v1.source: Pre-2026-09-06 `current` (no fit component). Kept for A/B comparison in scripts/evaluate_recommender.py --compare-profiles; not the default. fit=0 makes it loadable under the six-key schema while ranking exactly as before.

client-ad-v1.source: Pre-2026-09-06 `client-ad` (no fit component). Kept for A/B comparison; not the default. fit=0 makes it loadable under the six-key schema while ranking exactly as before.

results.no_result_policy: never pad beyond the hard budget/category filters; report the empty category explicitly in meta.empty_categories

feedback_rerank.note: bounded heuristic adjustment applied AFTER explainable scoring; not a trained model

diversity.note: applied after scoring, before truncation to max_results; identical or near-identical items are suppressed, and no single style may monopolise the final cut

fit.note: ADR-012. Per-category physical-fit rules; scores are in [0,1]; neutral_score when room or product dimensions are missing (or the category is footprint-neutral); never below floor. Dimensions are cm; footprint ratio = product (width x depth) / room (width x length) from the quiz. Seating/tables/storage: 1.0 up to ideal_footprint_ratio, linear decay to max_footprint_ratio; a side longer than the room, or no circulation_cm lane left along the short wall, is the floor. Rugs ramp UP from min to ideal (too small is the usual mistake) then decay to max. decor is height-only against assumed_ceiling_cm; lighting is neutral.
